border.insetHint: Distance of the border from the edge; left/right in addition to the label margin

info.unverified: Values from the printer's status block. '(unconfirmed)': per manufacturer documentation, not yet checked on the device.

toolbar.wizardHint: Templates (cables, patch panels …) and special elements like the distribution board label
